cards.title: APPRENTICE PAINTER
cards.concept: apprentice painter in a plain grey smock holding a wooden palette and brush at her chest, a small smudge of paint on one cheek, long straight dark hair tucked behind one ear
cards.hook: Head of Design: where every designer starts, with a brush and a gentle, focused smile

cards.title: LANTERN PUPPETEER
cards.concept: village puppeteer in a simple linen tunic holding a small wooden marionette in front of a glowing paper lantern, its shadow play cast behind her head
cards.hook: Entertainment Technology at Carnegie Mellon: storytelling through play and staging

cards.title: PRINTSHOP TYPESETTER
cards.concept: printer's apprentice in an ink-stained canvas apron holding a wooden composing stick of metal letter blocks at her chest, sleeves rolled up
cards.hook: typography and layout, the quiet craft under every screen she designs

cards.title: MASTER TAILOR
cards.concept: tailor in a grey waistcoat with a measuring tape draped around her neck, pins in the lapel and a pair of shears held near her shoulder
cards.hook: product designer: measuring twice, fitting the experience to the user

cards.title: JOURNEY MAPMAKER
cards.concept: cartographer in a plain leather vest holding up a parchment map with a winding dotted path, a quill tucked behind her ear
cards.hook: user journey maps: charting the route a user takes through a product

cards.title: CLOUD SHEPHERD
cards.concept: shepherdess in a green-trimmed wool cloak holding a shepherd's crook behind her shoulder while three tiny puffy clouds float beside her head like sheep
cards.hook: VMware: herding clouds, a pun on cloud and virtualization software

cards.title: PEACE COURIER
cards.concept: travelling courier in a green-trimmed riding jacket holding a sealed scroll at her chest, a small white dove perched on her shoulder
cards.hook: designing for the United Nations: carrying messages that bring people together

cards.title: PROTOTYPE TINKERER
cards.concept: artificer in a green leather apron with brass goggles pushed up on her head, cradling a small clockwork bird prototype mid-flutter
cards.hook: startups: build, test and iterate a prototype until it flies

cards.title: FIELD SKETCH RANGER
cards.concept: ranger in a green hooded-back tunic with the hood down, holding an open leather sketchbook at her chest, a charcoal pencil behind her ear and a small fox familiar on her shoulder
cards.hook: user research: observing people in the field and sketching what they need

cards.title: ILLUSIONIST
cards.concept: illusionist in flowing teal silk raising one hand to paint glowing teal interface shapes, circles, cards and buttons, in the air beside her face
cards.hook: product design: conjuring interfaces out of thin air

cards.title: CAROUSEL MAGE
cards.concept: stage mage in a teal velvet coat with a high collar holding a small spinning carousel that glows faintly teal, tiny lights orbiting it
cards.hook: Entertainment Technology at CMU: engineering wonder for theme parks, stages and games

cards.title: PALETTE ALCHEMIST
cards.concept: alchemist in teal-lined robes holding a round glass flask at her chest in which a swirling colour wheel glows, faint teal vapour curling up
cards.hook: colour systems: distilling a brand's palette into its purest form

cards.title: LUMEN ENCHANTRESS
cards.concept: enchantress in an ornate violet gown holding a crystal wand at her chest, glowing magenta butterflies of light circling her long dark hair, softly glowing violet eyes
cards.hook: her graceful, gentle calm, and the craft of adding delight to a design

cards.title: DREAMWEAVER
cards.concept: dreamweaver in violet rune-embroidered robes spinning glowing violet threads between her hands into a floating tapestry of tiny worlds behind her head
cards.hook: Digital Media at Pitzer and Head of Design: weaving many screens into one experience

cards.title: MUSE OF WORLDS
cards.concept: radiant muse of creation in gold and white regalia with a crescent-moon tiara and gold hair ornaments in her long dark hair, holding a starlight brush that paints a small golden world into being beside her, a blazing golden halo and orbiting stars behind her head
cards.hook: Head of Design at her ultimate: the calm, serene creator who designs whole worlds
